title: Counterfactual Reasoning for Steerable Pluralistic Value Alignment of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating how well models align with fine-grained pluralistic human values by comparing generated responses against target multi-dimensional value profiles (e.g., Schwartz's 10 Basic Human Values across different countries and simulated roles) using Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Spearman's Rank Correlation, and LLM-based value attribution.
